say:6:1721435009:0.text: Almost everyone in the fan club got this note.

say:7:1721435010:0.text: Anyway, I must say targeting the fan club was clever, since most members are wealthy. Still, we all saw right through it and didn't take it seriously.
say:7:1721435010:0.source_cn: 骗子也是精明，看准了后援团都是非富即贵的大小姐，但我们...

say:8:1721435011:0.text: But she hasn't been to any club events lately...
say:8:1721435011:0.source_cn: 但艾米最近都没来团里参加活动……

say:9:1721435012:0.text: She didn't know we received the same note... Could she have fallen for the scam?
say:9:1721435012:0.source_cn: 你说，艾米她……会不会因为不知道我们人手一封，就信了这个？

say:10:1721435013:0.text: Is that why she pawned off all her possessions yesterday?
say:10:1721435013:0.source_cn: 于是她昨天……就把所有东西都典当了？
